Help and keyboard controls

How to play

Use Predict → Choose → Check → Explain → Improve. Select an answer, match items using the lists, or move sequence steps with the arrow buttons. Mistakes receive a useful clue and a fresh same-skill question.

Easier wording and read-aloud

Every learning question includes Make this question easier. It changes the language, not the correct answer. Read-aloud uses your browser’s speech system; a message appears if the browser does not support it.

Keyboard

Tab moves through controls, Space/Enter activates buttons, arrow buttons move sequence items, and Escape closes menus or dialogs. In the slide viewer, Left/Right changes slide, Home/End jumps, and Escape exits full screen or closes the viewer.

Progress and certificates

Progress is saved only in this browser when local saving is enabled. Certificates unlock after the teacher-selected number of successful checks. Support use is recorded honestly but never reduces XP or blocks a certificate.

Practise missed skills

The missed-skills mode creates fresh questions that test the same knowledge without immediately repeating the original question.

Teacher quick paper test

Open Teacher Settings → Create Quick Paper Test. Choose the zones, question count, difficulty, paper layout and whether to include a word bank, marks, references and a separate answer key.

Printing

Printable items open in a clean new tab so they also work when this game is embedded. If the browser blocks the tab, choose Try Print Again or use the same-tab printable preview. In the print dialog, choose a printer or Save as PDF.

Safety

This resource supports learning but does not replace practical instruction, machinery training, supervision, local emergency procedures or teacher verification.
